subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard assertions are synchronized and the refreshed head passes exact-head workflow validation, should this bundled update to security- and secret-bearing actions be approved as one change?
rationale: The upstream revisions are authentic and no concrete security regression was found, but the protected `security` label and secops-owned workflows require a human to accept the bundled supply-chain update after the mechanical blockers are fixed.

options.title: Approve after synchronized repair
options.body: Keep the official tagged revisions together, update all three guard assertions, refresh the branch, and approve only after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Codex, and publishing-action changes for narrower security-owner review if the combined bundle is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after synchronized repair
recommendation.body: Keep the official tagged revisions together, update all three guard assertions, refresh the branch, and approve only after exact-head checks pass.
